body:
Pair rendering assertions with negative type checks and server tests where semantics depend on a database. Inspect skips and record DSNs' presence, server versions and extension limits in the verification result. Promise tags provide traceability, while actual assertions and executed suites provide behavioral evidence.

Evidence: ds:block?id=gate-9g2wphfm; ds:block?id=promise-gate-a57aksdv; ds:block?id=postgres-gate-ctc94x6a; ds:block?id=mysql-gate-xzbtwu8b; ds:block?id=postgres-extensions-j5kc5mqu. See docs/architecture.md and docs/operating-notes.md. Verified from the implementation and tests on 2026-11-01; server-test gates are explicitly distinguished from execution.
title: Use layered evidence for behavior claims
